description: This file defines a composable state holder for processing Base64-encoded images within an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes a data class representing the image state and a composable function that manages loading and decoding of Base64 images asynchronously.

classes.name: Base64ImageState
classes.description: A data class holding the decoded ImageBitmap and a boolean indicating failure.

methods.name: rememberBase64ImageState
methods.description: A composable function that manages the state of a Base64-encoded image, attempting to decode it asynchronously and track failure status.
